topic: Keurig Elite Review Premium Single vs Keurig Express Review Fast Simple
angle: Head-to-head: which of these two is the smarter buy for most people?

reviews.title: Keurig Elite Review Premium Single
pros: Excellent brew quality with Strong Brew button for bolder cups
Iced coffee setting brews hot and concentrated over ice

reviews.title: Keurig Express Review Fast Simple
